### Problem

When `make pre-pr` fails after the agent, neither the maintainer nor the fix round sees what failed, so the fix round guesses and may spend runs on the wrong thing.

### Scope

`scripts/autopilot.py` (the excerpt `verify` keeps and posts, and what the fix round reads) and its tests; the docs that describe the comment.

### Out of scope

Any repository's `make pre-pr`. Where and how long `make pre-pr` runs (#675).

### Acceptance criteria

C1: Given a `make pre-pr` log in which one parallel target fails early and another writes for long after, when the excerpt is built, then it holds the failing target's `make: ***` line and the error lines before it.
C2: Given a log larger than the excerpt's limit with its error near the start, when the excerpt is built, then the error is still in it.
C3: Given a passing `make pre-pr`, when it ends, then nothing changes from today.

### Criticality

Normal
